name: align-duplicate-line-added
description: e1 rewrites the middle line to `wait`. Afterwards something uncaptured adds a second, identical `wait` line next to it. Rule 5's unambiguous test: `start` and `stop` occur once on both sides and keep base. Between them the replayed state has one `wait` and the final file has two, so `wait` is not unique in the gap and the pairing is a coin flip (either line could be e1's). Both final `wait` lines are Unknown(noCapture); neither may keep e1.
